response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM order_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.customer_id, s.gender, s.order_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS gap_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value ORDER BY (s.share - a.value) IS NULL, gap_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
